newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse says CBS to stay in New York.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse says CBS to stay in New York.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Co's media units, CBS television and radio syndicator Infinity Broadcasting Corp, have decided to stay put in New York.

Westinghouse Chairman and Chief Executive Michael Jordan, appearing Monday at a news conference in City Hall with Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, said the media units were to remain in New York because it is the hub of the media industry.
The spinoff of Westinghouse's media business from the industrial unit, which is expected to be completed this summer, stirred the possibility that the media end could relocate.
The company said it considered other locations, including Hollywood, Westchester County in New York, and Pittsburgh, where the parent is based.
The company had planned to announce on Monday the new name of the CBS television network, but held off because of some outstanding "technical issues," Jordan said.
The new name and logo are now expected to be announced in early February, Jordan said.
((-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York newsdesk, 212-859-1709))
